task.description: Design a fix for ISS-0400 based on ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis in step-01-issue-fixer.json's result.summary (read it in full -- it names exact line numbers, functions, and the precise gap). In one sentence: collect_leaf_gateways/3's terminal clause (currently lines ~934-936 of lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex) treats every PARALLEL_GATEWAY node encountered as an immediate leaf, but a PARALLEL_GATEWAY that is itself a nested split (out-degree > 1, per the existing gateway_role/2 classification already used by dispatch_parallel_gateway/4) needs its own matching join recursively resolved first, with the outer walk then continuing from that inner join's own outgoing edge -- while a PARALLEL_GATEWAY that is actually a join/pass-through must keep today's immediate-terminal behavior unchanged (that is precisely what ISS-0398's fix depends on and must not regress). Your design must also state: (a) a termination argument for arbitrary nesting depth (the existing Tarjan-SCC memoization from ISS-0398 handles cycles for the OUTER walk -- state explicitly whether/how it composes with a RECURSIVE inner resolution without either infinite-looping or blowing the memo-key soundness ISS-0398's own design rework (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's memo-key-unsoundness catch, its BLOCKER-severity finding) already fixed once for the non-nested case -- read that finding via lib/letflow/design/iss0398-walk-to-gateway-fix.md before proposing a recursive call, since the same class of defect is the obvious risk here); (b) how a nested split's own resolution failure (e.g. no matching join found for the INNER split) should propagate to the outer branch's own find_matching_join/2 call -- as a distinct error reason, or folded into the existing :no_matching_join_found shape; (c) exact function signatures/@specs for whatever new or changed private function(s) this needs. Design artefact only -- no implementation code, no .ex function bodies (signatures/@specs and prose only, per WF-02 Step 1b check 2e).
acceptance_criteria: Design states the exact modified clause/function and its new logic, as a signature/@spec plus prose, not an implementation body
Nested-split resolution is explicitly recursive-or-not, with the termination argument stated for arbitrary nesting depth

Design explicitly re-examines ISS-0398's own Tarjan-SCC memoization for compatibility with the proposed recursive/iterative approach, addressing the same memo-key-unsoundness risk class CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already caught once on ISS-0398
Design states exactly how inner-split resolution failure propagates to the outer call, as a concrete error shape
Design explicitly confirms the existing non-nested PARALLEL_GATEWAY-as-join/pass-through path is unchanged (no regression of ISS-0398's own fix)
No .ex function bodies present in the design doc

result.summary:
Design written to lib/letflow/design/iss0400-nested-parallel-gateway-fix.md. Fix shape: collect_leaf_gateways/3's step-4 %Node{node_type: :PARALLEL_GATEWAY} clause (transition.ex:934-936) is split via the existing gateway_role/2 classification (transition.ex:730-741, reused verbatim): out_degree <= 1 (:join/:pass_through) keeps today's exact immediate-terminal body unchanged byte-for-byte (regression-safety-critical, confirmed in design §5 -- zero existing ISS-0398 fixture ever hits the new dispatch differently since none contains a nested :split-role PARALLEL_GATEWAY); out_degree > 1 (:split) is resolved via a new private function resolve_nested_split/3 (@spec Graph.t(), Node.t(), leaf_search_state() -> {leaf_search_result(), MapSet.t(branch_leaf()), leaf_search_state()}), which performs the same per-branch/cross-branch singleton-agreement fold find_matching_join/2 already does (reusing reset_stack_bookkeeping/1), then -- on success -- continues the walk from the inner join's own single outgoing edge's target via one more collect_leaf_gateways/3 call, returning that result as-is rather than stopping at the inner join (the diagnosis's explicit requirement). :combined_unsupported role folds into :dead_end (design open question #2, flagged for REVIEWER).

Recursion is explicit and stated as genuinely recursive, not iterative-unrolled (design §2) -- arbitrary nesting depth is real (a nested split's own branch can itself contain a further-nested split).

Termination for arbitrary depth (design §3.4): resolve_nested_split/3 introduces no new call shape -- every call it makes is an ordinary collect_leaf_gateways/3 call sharing the SAME state.memo, so ISS-0398 design §2.2.3's existing O(nodes+edges) bound already covers it without amending the counting argument; nesting depth itself is bounded by graph.ex's @max_nodes 500 (>= 3 new nodes per nesting level from gateway_role's own :split-requires-out_degree>1 definition, so depth <= 166) rather than assumed.

Memo-key soundness re-examined against ISS-0398's own BLOCKER finding (design §3.1-3.2), not merely asserted: the key design choice is that resolve_nested_split/3 NEVER writes memo[gw_node.id] itself for the nested split's own node_id -- it is a pure pass-through of values already memoized under THEIR OWN node_ids by ordinary recursive collect_leaf_gateways/3 calls, so no new memo key is introduced and the ISS-0398 §2.2.1 counterexample shape (two entry points seeing different partial views of one memo key) cannot recur at this boundary. state.memo IS shared/threaded into the recursive call (rejected the alternative of a fresh isolated state per §3.2, since that would reopen the O(2^k) blowup class SECURITY-REVIEWER's INV-8 finding fixed) while index/lowlink/stack/stack_set/next_index reset before the nested split's own sibling branches, identical discipline to find_matching_join/2's own existing fold. A worked micro-example (design §3.2) traces ISSUE-FIXER's own repro-1 graph shape end-to-end through the new machinery, confirming it resolves to {:ok, "outer_join"} where today's code returns {:error, {:no_matching_join_found, "outer_split"}}.

Inner-resolution failure propagation (design §3.3): folded into the existing :dead_end branch_leaf() variant, not a new error-reason constructor -- justified on 3 grounds (find_matching_join/2's own external error shape already collapses every internal failure mode into one {:error, :no_matching_join} regardless of cause; :dead_end already unions correctly with sibling paths' own :dead_end results inside the same MapSet without a new case; no caller/acceptance-criterion needs the distinction). One stated exception: a live {:open, lowlink} result from a nested split's own branch reaching back into a still-open outer-walk ancestor propagates through unchanged (not forced to :dead_end prematurely) -- fixture 3 (design §4) exercises this.

Non-regression of ISS-0398's own fix confirmed explicitly (design §5): the :join/:pass_through arm's body is byte-for-byte unchanged from today's shipped clause; dispatch_parallel_gateway/4's own RUNTIME dispatch path (separate from this lookahead-search fix) is untouched; find_matching_join/2's own external signature/agreement rule is untouched; every existing ISS-0398 fixture (three_branch_graph/0, branch_with_exclusive_gateway_graph/0, diamond_chain_graph/1, cyclic_escape_graph/0 and twin, pure_cycle_no_escape_graph/0) contains zero :split-role PARALLEL_GATEWAY nodes, so all hit the identical dispatch path as today.

4 worked fixtures specified for TEST-DESIGNER (design §4): nested_parallel_split_graph/0 (core regression, ISSUE-FIXER's repro-1 shape), nested_split_dead_end_graph/0 (negative case), nested_split_reentrant_cycle_graph/0 (exercises the {:open,_}-propagation exception), doubly_nested_parallel_split_graph/0 (depth-2 confirmation).

No .ex function bodies present -- verified via grep for def/defp/case-do/Enum.reduce/Enum.map/Map.put patterns across the design doc, zero matches; only @spec fences and prose, matching ISS-0398's own design-doc convention. 3 open questions listed explicitly in §7 (fold-sharing between the two per-branch folds; whether :combined_unsupported deserves a distinct outcome; whether fixture 3 needs its own unit-level test) rather than silently resolved.
